Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Distressed Handtufted Cotton and Wool Area Rug 4' x 6', Gold and Cream
Colors: Olive/Beige
Materials: wool
The distressed look of this cotton-and-wool handtufted rug will add a modern accent to your space, but the warm gold and cream coloring is flexible enough to work with any decor. A semiplush pile will soften and brighten bare areas while bringing warmth and comfort. 4'W x 6'L 80% wool, 20% cotton Handtufted with a distressed pattern A medium pile of 0.4" suits any indoor space. Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
